sentences.en: I don't think I have the stamina to do that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没有足够的耐力去完成那件事。

sentences.en: Sam doesn't have the stamina to finish a marathon.
sentences.zh: 萨姆没有跑完马拉松的体力。

sentences.en: You need a lot of stamina to add ten thousand sentences.
sentences.zh: 你需要很大的耐力才能添加一万句句子。

senses.zh: 体力，耐力，持久力；雄蕊( stamen的名词复数)；毅力
